file.title: Files
file.description: Upload and manage game assets. Organize them into folders and drag items onto a folder to move them; drag files or whole folders from your computer below to upload.

selection.hint: Click to select; hold Shift/Ctrl to select more, or drag on empty space. Double-click to open; drag onto a folder to move.

empty.title: No files yet
empty.uploadHint: Drop files here, or use “Upload” at the top right.

upload.queued: Added {{count}} files to the upload queue

delete.title: Delete file
delete.confirm: Delete “{{name}}”? It will be moved to the trash and can be restored within the retention period.

delete.title: Delete files
delete.confirm: Delete {{count}} files? They are deleted one by one in the background and moved to the trash, where they can be restored within the retention period.

deleteFolder.title: Delete folders
deleteFolder.confirm: Delete {{count}} items? Selected folders will be moved to the trash together with their files and subfolders. Deletion runs in the background, and items can be restored within the retention period.

preview.title: File details
preview.truncated: Large file: showing the first {{size}} only. Download it for the full content.
preview.unsupported: This file type can't be previewed yet. Download it to open.
preview.tooLarge: This file is too large to preview in the browser. Download it to open.
preview.deletedDescription: Someone may have just deleted this file.

delete.title: Delete folder
delete.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Every file and subfolder inside it will be moved to the trash as well and can be restored within the retention period.

restore.success: Restored “{{name}}” with its files and subfolders.
restore.partial: Restored “{{name}}”, but the contents of {{count}} files no longer exist and could not be restored.
restore.nameConflict: A folder with the same name already exists here. Rename or move it before restoring.

access.lockedTitle: You don't have access to this folder
access.lockedDescription: You can see its subfolders but not its files. Ask the folder's managers or an administrator for access.
access.pendingDescription: Your request has been sent and is waiting for the folder's managers or an administrator.
access.alreadyPending: You already have a pending request

share.title: Share “{{name}}”
share.description: Access applies to this folder and all of its subfolders. People with global file permissions (such as administrators) are not affected.
share.empty: No one has been given access yet
share.subject: Who
share.everyone: Everyone who can use the file manager
share.subjectSearchUser: Search users by name or username
share.inheritHint: Turning this off makes the folder private: only the entries below can access it (people with global file permissions still can). Access inherited right now is copied here so no one loses access immediately; remove entries afterwards.

levelHints.contributor: Upload and create subfolders; rename and delete their own uploads
levelHints.editor: Rename, move and delete anyone's files
levelHints.manager: Everything an editor can do, plus manage access to this folder

restore.parentDeleted: The folder it was in has been deleted. Restore the folder first from the Folders tab of the trash.
restore.objectMissing: The contents of this file no longer exist, so it cannot be restored.

explain.title: Check access
explain.hint: Pick a user to see what they can do in this folder and through which grant.
